strings.subtitle: — Isibhubhisi sefayela —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ukuhudula nokudonsa akutholakali. Sebenzisa inkinobho engezansi.
strings.shred_button: B H U B H I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Isexwayiso! Ku-SSD indlela yokubhala phezu akuginisekisi ukubhujiswa ngenxa ye-TRIM.
Uhlelo lwe-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayela elithi "{name}" lizobhalwa phezu futhi lisuswe.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Lesi yisifinyezo (.lnk). Isifinyezo kuphela esizobhujiswa.

Ifayela eliqondiwe elikukhomba lizohlala lingaphelele.

Qhubeka?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Lena i-network drive (\\server\share).
Ukubhala phezu kwesekhodi akuqinisekisi ukubhujiswa — iseva ingaba nama-snapshot, deduplication noma i-CoW.

Qhubeka?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Lena i-removable drive (USB / HDD yangaphandle).
Isilawuli singagcina amabhulokhi amadala endaweni yokugcina.

Qhubeka?
strings.report_limits:
• Imifudlana yedatha ehlukile ye-NTFS (ADS) ayicutshungulwa.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayihlanjululwa.
• Amakhophi ethunzi nokuvumelanisa kwefu
  (OneDrive njll.) akuthinteki.
strings.status_full: Okuqukethwe kubhalwe phezu ngokugcwele ngamaqanda. Ukubuyisela akunakwenzeka — amathuluzi azobona amaqanda kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Ikhanda, umsila nemigqa engu-4 MB kubhalwe phezu. Okunye akuthintekile, kodwa ngenxa yezikhala ukubuyisela okugcwele ngamathuluzi omsebenzisi akunakwenzeka. Emadokhumentini ayimfihlo sebenzisa imodi EGCOWELE.
strings.status_empty: Ifayela lalingenalutho, ukubhala phezu kwakungadingeki. Lasuswa.
strings.error_permission: Ayikwazi ukufinyelela ifayela. Kungenzeka ukuthi livuliwe kwenye uhlelo. Vala bese uzama futhi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Lena i-symbolic link. Ama-link awakwazi ukubhujiswa — ifayela eliqondiwe lizohlala lingaphelele.
strings.error_reparse: Leli i-placeholder yefayela (OneDrive noma efanayo). Idatha yalo igcinwe efwini, hhayi kudiski — akukho lutho oluzobhujiswa lapha.
strings.error_not_file: Leli akulona ifayela (ifolda noma enye into). Yehla ifayela.
strings.error_hardlinks: Leli fayela linamanye ama-hard link ({n} isiyonke). Ama-hard link awanawo owokuqala — wonke amagama ayalingana. Uma ubhubhisa ngendlela yamanje, idatha izobhalwa phezu kwayo futhi inqanyulwe ibe ngu-32 bytes, kodwa insalela izohlala ifinyeleleka ngamanye ama-link. Susa wonke ama-link kuqala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayela licindezelwe, lishunqiselwe noma li-sparse. Ukubhala ngo-zero akuqinisekisi ukubhujiswa kwedatha endala ngoba i-NTFS iyigcina ngendlela ehlukile.

Susa i-attribute: chofoza kwesokudla → Izakhiwo → Okuthuthukile → susa uphawu lwe 'Cindezela' kanye/noma 'Shunqisela'. Bese ugijima i-SHREDDER futhi.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Amafayela angu-{count} azobhujiswa.
Usayizi ophelele: {size}.

Hlola uhlu ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
Lesi senzo asikwazi ukuhlehliswa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Susa wonke amafayela angu-{count} emgqeni?

Amafayela ngokwawo ANAYI KUTHINTWA — uhlu kuphela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Ifayela "{name}" linamanye ama-hard link ({nlink} isiyonke).

Idatha izobhujiswa kuwo wonke amagama.
Kodwa izinsalela (32 bytes) zizohlala ngaphansi kwamanye amagama kufolda.

Ungase udinge ukususa lezi zinsalela ngesandla.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Sebenzisa kuwo wonke ama-hard link emgqeni
